name: RogueScape
summary:
RogueScape is an old-school MMO-inspired survival roguelike where every run starts with a build choice: pick your skills, survive escalating waves, open chests, and turn permanent account progress into stronger future runs.

Choose from combat, gathering, production, and support skills before each run. Swing swords with Attack, fire piercing arrows with Ranged, chain lightning through groups with Magic, orbit shields with Defense, smash enemies with Strength, or lean into survival tools like Woodcutting, Mining, Fishing, Cooking, Smithing, Herblore, Crafting, Agility, and Slayer. Your selected skills level up during the run, unlocking stronger effects and stranger synergies as the pressure builds.

Runs are built around survival, decision-making, and momentum. Enemies are fewer and tougher than a typical swarm game, so kills matter, positioning matters, and each upgrade can change how your build handles the next wave. Last long enough and the Reaper arrives to bring the run to its final reckoning.

Between runs, your account keeps growing. XP earned in a run feeds permanent skill progression, giving that familiar long-term grind a roguelike loop: lose, learn, level, rebuild, and come back stronger.
